watchlist: open — no fixed list. User may name any NSE/BSE equity; agent may search via symbol_search and analyse any valid ticker.

bias_criteria.bullish: Price above 50-day EMA on daily, RSI between 45 and 70, higher highs and higher lows on 4H, volume rising on up days
bias_criteria.bearish: Price below 50-day EMA on daily, RSI below 45, lower highs and lower lows on 4H
bias_criteria.neutral: Price chopping around 50-day EMA, RSI 40-60, no clear structure — wait

no_trades_during: earnings release day unless user confirms
Budget day / RBI policy day for index-heavy setups

agent_permissions.tradingview: full — switch any NSE/BSE symbol, change timeframe, add/remove indicators, draw on chart, set alerts, screenshots, Pine Script, replay simulation, batch scans
agent_permissions.zerodha_kite: none — do NOT place real broker orders unless user explicitly connects Kite Connect API later. Output Kite-ready order tickets for user to click buy/sell manually.

analysis_style: User names a stock or asks for a scan. Use symbol_search for unknown tickers. Prefer large/mid caps for suggestions unless user specifies small cap.
